name: instant-save
title: Instant Save
summary: Saves Settings > Main Menu changes at once.
description: Without this patch, the iPod saves only when it sleeps or connects to a computer. A restart with Menu+Select loses the change.
details: A change in Settings > Main Menu stays after a restart with Menu+Select.
This includes the Album Artists row.
notes: Each change writes the settings file. On an iPod with a hard drive, the drive can start.
Other settings, for example Shuffle and Repeat, still save only at a sleep.

steps: Flash a firmware with this patch.
On the iPod, open Settings > Main Menu.
Change a row, for example Songs.
Restart the iPod: hold Menu and Select.
Open Settings > Main Menu. The change is still there.
